hypotheses.representation_type: implicit-derivative representation of a tanh fixed-point residual
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Let theta=w*z+x. G0001 is F(theta)-z. G0002 is F'(theta)=1/cosh(theta)^2. G0003 is the implicit partial derivative of z with respect to x from G0001=0, namely F'(theta)/(1-w*F'(theta)), which rewrites to 1/(cosh(theta)^2-w).
hypotheses.rationale: The three source expressions share the same composed argument theta=w*z+x. G0001 is the residual of the fixed-point equation z=tanh(theta); G0002 is the derivative of the tanh kernel; G0003 is the corresponding implicit partial derivative obtained by differentiating the residual, matching the current source expression.
